Name: Sān-Z Beats: Drumbeat
Desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
Desc2:
This figure is based on the drummer of the band that designer Yi works with, who is also one of the spokesboo of the Bangboo clothing brand under Sān-Z STUDIO.
Due to limitations in the instrument size, it always needs an extra amplifier during performances, compared to human drummers.
